verdict.rationale: Skyfire's documented flow directly matches the story: agents get a pre-funded wallet/API key (checkout session), create kya/pay/kya-pay delegated payment tokens with committed amounts, and sellers charge those tokens with guaranteed settlement, all orchestrated via the Skyfire MCP server's find-sellers/create-token/charge-token tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of an actual end-to-end completed purchase, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s), so all evidence is first-party documentation.
